steps.description: Design a high-fidelity layered 3D ring drawable with glossy neon highlights and shadow bevels to function as the rotating loader core.

steps.title: Revamp Layout with Full-Screen 3D Loader Overlay
steps.description: Embed an immersive, full-screen interactive 3D splash loader layout with real-time status indicators and progress text directly inside the main workspace.

steps.title: Define Skeuomorphic Color Palettes
steps.description: Confirm deep colors and bevel layers inside colors.xml.

steps.description: Maintain 3D tactile button selectors for the numerical keypad keys.

steps.title: Verify Operator Key Elements
steps.description: Confirm the vibrant orange keycap surfaces for arithmetic calculation keys.

steps.title: Verify Accessory Key Elements
steps.description: Verify tactile indicators for clearance and backspace buttons.

steps.description: Confirm high-contrast green highlight on press states.

steps.title: Fix Z-Axis View Rotation Call
steps.description: Replace non-existent View.setRotationZ(float) with standard View.setRotation(float) to resolve compiling issue.

steps.title: Build Dual-Axis Loader Rotation Engine
steps.description: Write matrix logic programmatically translating standard 2D views into pitch and yaw space to make loader components spin on separate dimensions in actual 3D.

steps.description: Wire a timer-driven loop updating load percentages and mock system diagnostics synchronously to keep users engaged.

steps.title: Preserve Gyroscopic Interactive 3D Effects

steps.title: Implement Fade-Out Overlay Dismissal
steps.description: Construct scale-up and fade-out animations to elegantly transition from the 3D loading overlay into the calculator workspace with sound chime success cues.

steps.title: Verify High-Performance Mathematical Engine
steps.description: Confirm accuracy in expressions, brackets, percentages, and history logging triggers.

steps.title: Validate Safety Lifecycles & Handles
steps.description: Confirm audio instances and sensor parameters gracefully release onPause or onDestroy states.
